name: Digital Wellbeing
author: nihalebr
description: Tracks which applications you use the most and for how long, like Android's Digital Wellbeing. A bar icon opens a breakdown of today's screen time by app, an hourly timeline, and the last seven days.

barWidget.description: Screen-time tracker with a per-app breakdown popup

schema.label: Show today's total in the bar
schema.description: When On, the bar shows the running screen-time total next to the icon.

schema.label: Daily goal (minutes)
schema.description: Optional. When set, the popup shows progress toward this limit and the bar icon turns urgent once you pass it. 0 disables the goal.

schema.label: Count as away after (seconds idle)
schema.description: Time with no keyboard or mouse input before tracking pauses.

schema.label: Sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the focused window is polled. Lower is more precise, higher is lighter.

schema.label: History to keep (days)
schema.description: Day files older than this are pruned on startup.
